newsitem.title: NORWAY: Moelven and Norske Skog disagreed on share ratio.
newsitem.headline: Moelven and Norske Skog disagreed on share ratio.

text.p: Norwegian forestry group Moelven Industrier ASA said on Monday the merger talks with Norske Skog ASA derailed because of disagreement on the share ratio.
"The parties had wanted such a merger in order to strengthen the industrial basis for the business, but failed to agree on the share ratio," Moelven said in a statement to the Oslo Bourse.
Norske Skog earlier announced the talks on merging their units for saw mills and board production had been dropped, but did not specify the reason.
Jarle Langfjaeran, deputy financial director at Norske Skog, said there were no plans to resume the talks.
"You cannot rule out anything, but as far as I know there are no concrete plans to resume the talks in the near future," he told Reuters.
